description: cfd_3d_pier_komega_amr with the units placed for the load of the 2 ranks (G 40 1): the patches around the pier on the rank of their unit, the level-0 cells under them on the other rank; the pieces of the solid surface on the rank of the finest grid (level 0 leaves out those under the patches on every rank). The units are cut at the front face of the pier (x 0.4): the fluid cells in front of it on one patch, the pier on the next; the direct forcing flags and the wall law of k-omega across the patch edge, the pressure around the patches at the end of the step (probes, surface pieces at the cut).
covers: cfd_amr::force_objects (no force objects on the shadows), cfd_amr::patch_forces with G 40 1
ghostcell::gcdf_update on a patch: the flags of the cells around it from their own fields (a surface at the patch edge)
cfd_amr::fill_press_out (the probes and the force pieces next to a patch edge)
